summary: ParaZero Technologies Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated September 9, 2026, announcing a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding with an unnamed Tier-1 European defense company to integrate ParaZero's DefendAir net-based counter-UAS physical interception technology into armored vehicle platforms as a vehicle-integrated active protection system. No financial terms, ownership stakes, prices, premiums, or close dates were disclosed. The MOU follows an initial DefendAir Net Pods purchase, with ParaZero engineers set to travel to the European partner's facility for on-site integration support and joint demonstration. This is an ordinary business development disclosure, not a special situation; watch for a definitive agreement and any revenue contribution.
